items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He asked me, “Can you copy?” And I said, “Yes sir.” And so I copied some of the scores for him.

ctx.x: Yeah. It was an old theatre, it was the Peerless Theatre, that was the name of it. And I would go by the rehearsals. One of the things that I am very proud of, remember the name Reginald Forthsyte?

items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: One of the things that I am very proud of, remember the name Reginald Forthsyte? ... Right. He wrote a theme song called Deep Forest.
